[1/3] Plan crew service medals: track captain victories and away missions, award persistent medals with morale, and surface them in the crew roster, CLI and codex.

impact_assessment.why: Crew progression stops at skill and morale; captains and away teams complete dangerous service without any lasting recognition or visible history.
impact_assessment.benefits: Dangerous service produces named medals, captains and explorers gain a morale reward, and the crew roster and codex show career history.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CrewMember gains medals and two counters with legacy-safe defaults; dependency: battle victory and away resolution must increment counters exactly once; concurrency: both paths update crew inside existing engine-locked flows; state: medals must persist and never duplicate on reload.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test medal thresholds, no duplication, battle and away increments, persistence, codex metric and UI/CLI wiring first; award through one pure helper; verify the live crew tab.
